## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated rewrite. / 改动聚焦，没有无关重写。
- [ ] Tests cover success, failure, and boundary cases. / 测试覆盖成功、失败与边界情况。
- [ ] I ran the relevant CI-equivalent checks. / 已运行相关的 CI 等价检查。
- [ ] Protocol changes update shared contracts and fixtures. / 协议变化已更新共享契约与夹具。
- [ ] User-facing docs are synchronized in Chinese and English. / 用户文档已同步中英文。
- [ ] Skills, templates, validators, and runtime schemas are updated when deployment behavior changes. / 部署行为变化已同步操作流程、模板、验证器和运行记录。
- [ ] No credentials, private deployment data, local config, or build artifacts are included. / 未包含凭据、私有部署数据、本地配置或构建产物。
- [ ] New dependencies have a clear need and compatible license. / 新依赖必要且许可证兼容。
- [ ] I understand and verified all submitted content, including AI-assisted work. / 已理解并验证全部提交内容，包括 AI 辅助内容。
